title: Order-six quantum Latin square of cardinality 29
claim: There exists a real quantum Latin square of order 6 with cardinality 29.

baseline.source: Zhipeng Xu, New Cardinalities for Quantum Latin Squares of Order Six, arXiv:2607.11800v3
baseline.boundary: The paper states that 29 is the single unresolved order-six cardinality.
